match.operational_viability_reason: Official LaLiga table/match data, official Atlético and Deportivo team news, current form and confirmed XIs are available.
match.common_evidence_basis: Fresh exception research confirms a materially attacking Atlético XI: Oblak; Llorente, Pubill, Hancko, Grimaldo; Barrios, Hjulmand; Kang-In Lee, Lookman, Baena; Julián Álvarez. LaLiga lists Atlético 2nd with 22 points, 19 scored and 8 conceded after nine; Deportivo are 9th with 11 points, 13 scored and 12 conceded. Atlético's recent sequence is 1-1 Stuttgart, 1-0 Espanyol, 2-0 Manchester United, 2-1 Alavés, 2-1 Real Madrid and 4-0 Osasuna. Deportivo recently drew Levante 1-1, lost 2-3 at Real Sociedad, drew Betis 1-1, lost 0-1 Sevilla, drew Getafe 1-1 and won 3-2 at Villarreal. Deportivo officially confirm Aubameyang, Eddahchouri, Casadó and Bright Ede unavailable, but the confirmed XI still contains Mella, Yeremay, Nsongo and Mario Soriano. The new XI clearly upgrades Atlético chance quality, but the current league sample still contains repeated one/two-goal Atlético endpoints and repeated Deportivo 1-1s.
match.main_failure: The confirmed Atlético XI is aggressively selected, but their recent competitive run repeatedly stops at one or two goals and Deportivo have three recent 1-1 league draws. Atlético played in Stuttgart on Tuesday before this Saturday match. Deportivo's current attack remains usable but not strong enough to guarantee a rescue route. The evidence therefore improves route quality without establishing a protected third goal.
match.h2h_basis: The direct series is old and not used as a tactical veto; the current comparable league scoring/control sample is more relevant. Historical Deportivo scoring difficulty in Madrid is only a secondary caution.

match.upper_tail_comparable_context_basis: The closest current senior sample is dominated by Atlético 1-0/2-0/2-1 and Deportivo 1-1/0-1/1-1 outcomes rather than repeated four-goal completion.
